# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.5 Worker 4: Western Europe (oe_weu2_, Slot 93, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v115_western_europe.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 93 entry: scheduler host scope, once a quarter. Only world-level state lives here; the countries
# of the theatre are checked by their own quarterly pulse (on_action/oe_weu2_pulse.txt).
oe_weu2_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_pulse_count add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1510
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active }
			NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
			country_exists = c:POR
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1622
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission }
			NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
			country_exists = c:PAP
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope: a protagonist's quarterly check.
oe_weu2_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_syn_cd }
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_arsenale_maritime_shipyards
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_syn_cd years = 15 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu2_shipyard_synergy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu2_full_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	oe_weu2_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one story event whose condition holds.
oe_weu2_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1520
			oe_weu2_is_empire_actor = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev3_done }
			oe_weu2_is_empire_actor = yes
			OR = {
				current_year >= 1618
				situation:war_of_religions = { situation_is_active = yes }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev4_done }
			current_year >= 1640
			OR = {
				tag = BRA
				tag = PRU
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev6_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			owns = location:rome
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev6_done value = 1 }

	else_if = {

			has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev13_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev14_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev14_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.14

	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev1_done }

		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev5_done }
			is_ai = yes

			oe_weu2_is_empire_actor = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_weu2_ev7_done }
			is_ai = yes
			tag = PAP
			has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_weu2_ev7_done value = 1 }

# Country scope. Portugal's three keys of the Indian Ocean and its pass system (this worker is the only writer of
# the global variable). The second modifier is a bonus for a country that also carries the vice-royalty variable.
oe_weu2_grant_por_cartaz_network = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu2_carreira_da_india_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = por_estado_da_india }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_weu2_viceroyalty_synergy_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Any scope. The mission to Asia has set out (this worker is the only writer of the global variable).
oe_weu2_send_asia_mission = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_weu2_jesuit_asia_mission value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. The event that goes with a chartered company depends on who founds it.
oe_weu2_company_event = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { tag = HOL tag = NED }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = { tag = ENG tag = GBR }
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.11
	}
	else = {
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_weu2.12
	}
}

# Dev panel: research this theatre's advances.
oe_weu2_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_weu2_adv_reichsreform_circles } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_weu2_adv_reichsreform_circles
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_weu2_adv_albuquerque_chokepoints } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_weu2_adv_albuquerque_chokepoints
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_weu2_adv_propaganda_fide_cartography } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_weu2_adv_propaganda_fide_cartography
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_weu2_adv_joint_stock_line_of_battle } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_weu2_adv_joint_stock_line_of_battle
	}
}
